name: APEX Internet
summary: Canberra's favourite ISP (dialup + hosting); acquired ORAC 2001, renamed Apex Telecom ~Nov 2011, absorbed CyberOne customers Jun 2012, sold to NetSpeed Communications Jun 2012 (APEX TELECOM PTY. LTD., ACN 152 018 436).

events.details: Apex Internet operating since 1997 (one of Canberra's leading ISPs since 97); earliest capture 5 Dec 1998.
Sold to NetSpeed Communications (June 2012); ultimate holding Velocity Internet.
